repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-ai-assistant
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.aiassistant. register() connects the shared mercury socket and listens for assistant-api events; makeAiAssistantRequest and four meeting helpers (summarizeMeeting, wasMyNameMentioned, showAllActionItems, askMeAnything) POST a chunked request to the assistant-api service, encrypting question text with the caller's KMS key, and resolve with a requestId, sessionId, and streamEventName. Response chunks arriving over mercury are decrypted by content type and re-emitted on the aiassistant:stream event named for that requestId, with a plugin-generated timeout event when no chunk arrives within requestTimeout. It stores nothing.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-ai-assistant package entry
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers AIAssistant as internal plugin 'aiassistant' with config {aiassistant: {requestTimeout: 60000}}; the first registration of the name wins. The default export is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.aiassistant methods and events
public_interfaces.notes: Requests resolve with {...body, requestId, streamEventName}; chunks arrive on aiassistant:stream:{requestId} only after register(). Other events: aiassistant:registered, aiassistant:unregistered, aiassistant:activityReceived.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not refer to the plugin as webex.internal.aiAssistant.
negative_guidance.why: src/index.ts registers it as aiassistant and webex-core keys internal plugins by that raw name; only the README and the unit spec's MockWebex mount use aiAssistant.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not expect a stream without register().
negative_guidance.why: Chunks arrive over mercury, which register() connects and subscribes to; the HTTP response only acknowledges the request.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not emit a stream event without requestId and finished.
negative_guidance.why: Clients correlate on requestId and stop on finished.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log questions, answers, or decrypted fields.
negative_guidance.why: They are meeting content; existing log lines carry only error messages and content names.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the namespace, event, or payload reference.
negative_guidance.why: Several of its claims differ from code; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The legacy Jest config sets no threshold and no coverage script exists.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example registration, the four meeting helpers, the default timeout duration, or decryption failure. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
